verdict.rationale: mParticle versions its APIs per surface and documents migrations, such as the DSR API v1/v2 to v3 upgrade guide and a Warehouse Sync API v2 migration, and it keeps a dated changelog. However, the evidence says no policy page states notice periods or lifecycle guarantees, so the deprecation-policy half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with notice periods and sunset timelines, lifecycle or support guarantees per API version, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: mParticle versions its APIs per surface with documented migrations, e.g. the Data Subject Request API v3 upgrade guide
The vendor maintains a dated changelog at changelog.mparticle.com
